messages.content:
How to generate a RESTful API request on Cisco Nexus Dashboard?
Version: 6.3.1
IP: 192.120.45.67
API name: get information of an interface
Parameter_fabricName: Network1
Parameter_nodeId: 12
Parameter_podId: 10
Parameter_interfaceType: Ethernet
Parameter_infoType: Speed

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Send a GET request to retrieve specified information for an interface from a network telemetry API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL endpoint to send the GET request to. This should include the base path without query parameters, e.g., 'https://{ip}/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo'.

params.description: The query parameters for the request.

fabricName.description: The name of the fabric to limit nodes pertaining to.

nodeId.description: The node identifier to limit results pertaining to.

podId.description: The pod identifier to limit results pertaining to.

interfaceType.description: The type of the interface to limit results pertaining to.

infoType.description: The type of information requested for the interface.

message.reasoning:
We need to generate a RESTful API request on Cisco Nexus Dashboard. Provide the request details. Use the function to call the API? The user wants to know how to generate a RESTful API request. We can provide the URL and query parameters. Also maybe show how to use curl or python requests. The function is defined to send a GET request. We can call it with the given parameters. The base URL: https://{ip}/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo. So we need to replace {ip} with 192.120.45.67. Then query parameters: fabricName=Network1, nodeId=12, podId=10, interfaceType=Ethernet, infoType=Speed. Provide the full URL with query string. Also mention authentication (likely token). Provide example using curl: curl -X GET "https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo?fabricName=Network1&nodeId=12&podId=10&interfaceType=Ethernet&infoType=Speed" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -k. Or python requests: import requests; url="https://192.120.45.67/..."; params={...}; r=requests.get(url, params=params, headers={"Authorization":"Bearer <token>"}, verify=False). Print r.json().

Also mention that the API name is get information of an interface. Provide the function call: functions.requests_get({url:"https://192.120.45.67/sedgeapi/v1/cisco-nir/api/api/telemetry/flowrules/interfaceInfo", params:{fabricName:"Network1", nodeId:12, podId:10, interfaceType:"Ethernet", infoType:"Speed"}}). But the function expects interfaceType values: "gigabitethernet" | "fastethernet" | "ethernet" | "serial". So "Ethernet" should be lowercase "ethernet". Also infoType: "Speed" but allowed values: "statistics" | "status" | "config" | "Speed". "Speed" is allowed. So we need to pass "ethernet" not "Ethernet". Provide note.

Thus answer: Provide the request details, example code, and function call.
